title: Daily Report
subtitle: Activity for one calendar date in the shop time zone ({{timezone}}), not a cashier shift report.
heading: Date {{date}} · time zone {{timezone}} · generated at {{time}}

sales.title: Sales activity
sales.basis: Invoices finalized on this date, including ones voided later. Cashier filter = the finalizing cashier.

voids.title: Voids
voids.basis: Invoices voided on this date, whenever they were sold; their amount is deducted on the void day. Cashier filter = the voiding cashier.

payments.title: Payment activity
payments.basis: Money received on this date, including payments on earlier invoices. Cashier filter = the receiving cashier.
payments.openingChannelNote: Channel filters exclude opening balance repayments because they have no invoice channel.

actions.csvSeparatorNote: The CSV uses commas. If Excel shows everything in one column (the Windows list separator is a semicolon), open it with Data > From Text/CSV and choose Comma as the delimiter.

outcome.PRINTER_NOT_FOUND: Printer “{{printerName}}” was not found. Check the printer or the print settings.
outcome.PRINT_FAILED: The report could not be printed. Try again.
outcome.PRINT_TIMEOUT: The printer did not respond in time. Check the printer and try again.
outcome.PDF_FAILED: The report could not be printed. Try again.
outcome.EXPORT_FAILED: The CSV could not be saved. Try again or choose another location.
